findings.title: OnInitializedAsync methods lack exception handling in all three page components
findings.rule_violated: Blazor best practice: lifecycle methods that perform I/O should catch exceptions and display user-friendly errors
findings.remediation: Wrap OnInitializedAsync bodies in try-catch; set an errorMessage field to display in the UI rather than crashing to the global error boundary.

findings.title: BackupDatabase invoked on every Setup page load and every mutation, causing excessive localStorage writes
findings.rule_violated: Performance: full-database export + base64 encode + localStorage write on every CRUD operation is excessive I/O in a browser runtime
findings.remediation: Decouple backup from RefreshData. Save on a debounced timer, on page navigation away (Dispose), or use a dirty flag to track whether data has changed since last save.

findings.title: No localStorage quota check before storing multi-MB SQLite backup
findings.evidence_snippet:
await LocalStorage.SetItemAsStringAsync("db_backup", Convert.ToBase64String(data));
// No QuotaExceededError handling, no size threshold check before storing
findings.rule_violated: Defensive programming: browser localStorage has 5-10MB origin quota; exceeding it throws QuotaExceededError which is uncaught here
findings.remediation: Check data.Length against a safe threshold (e.g., 4MB) before writing. Wrap SetItemAsStringAsync in try-catch for QuotaExceededError. Show a user warning when the backup cannot be saved.

findings.title: Bootstrap JavaScript not loaded in index.html — accordion UI in Judging page is non-functional
findings.evidence_snippet:
<!-- index.html:9-11 -- only Bootstrap CSS, no JS -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="lib/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" />

<!-- Judging.razor:97 -- depends on Bootstrap JS which is never loaded -->
<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
        data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#manualEntry">
    Manual Override / Correction
</button>
findings.rule_violated: Functional correctness: Bootstrap JS-dependent components (accordion) are broken because the JS bundle is not referenced
findings.remediation: Add <script src="lib/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script> to index.html before </body>. Or replace the Bootstrap accordion with Blazor-native conditional rendering (@if (showManualEntry) { ... }) to eliminate the JS dependency.

findings.title: Interactive div elements missing ARIA roles, keyboard handlers, and tabindex
findings.evidence_snippet:
<!-- Clickable divs acting as buttons without button semantics -->
<div class="judge-card h-100 text-center p-5 ..."
     @onclick="() => RecordResult(Operator.GreaterThan)">
    <!-- No role="button", no tabindex, no @onkeydown -->

<!-- Toggle button without aria-label -->
<button title="Navigation menu" class="navbar-toggler" @onclick="ToggleNavMenu">
findings.rule_violated: WCAG 2.1: 4.1.2 Name/Role/Value — interactive elements must expose their role and state to assistive technology; 2.1.1 Keyboard — all functionality must be operable through keyboard
findings.remediation: Replace judge-card divs with <button> elements for built-in ARIA semantics, or add role="button", tabindex="0", @onkeydown handlers for Enter/Space, and aria-label to each div. Add aria-keyshortcuts="A S D" to the judging container. Add aria-label to the navbar toggle button.

findings.title: Large lists rendered without Virtualize component
findings.rule_violated: Performance: rendering 200+ items without Virtualize causes unnecessary DOM nodes, memory usage, and slow initial render
findings.remediation: Replace @foreach with <Virtualize Items="@categories" Context="cat"> for lists that can exceed ~50 items. Relations list and leaderboard are the best candidates.

findings.title: DB restore path lacks schema version, integrity, and basic validity checks (SEC-004 follow-up)
findings.rule_violated: CWE-345 Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity; defensive programming: restore should validate data before committing
findings.remediation: Prepend a schema version number to the backup payload. On restore, compare to the expected version; reject mismatches. Validate the SQLite header magic bytes (first 16 = 'SQLite format 3') before writing. Run a simple SELECT 1 query post-restore to confirm DB integrity.

findings.title: Console.WriteLine used for error logging instead of ILogger<T>
findings.rule_violated: Observability: unstructured Console output cannot be filtered by log level and loses stack trace context
findings.remediation: Inject ILogger<T> into startup code via builder.Services.BuildServiceProvider(). Replace Console.WriteLine with _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to restore database").

findings.title: Orphaned weather.json scaffold file in production wwwroot output
findings.rule_violated: Clean code: scaffold/template artifacts should be removed before production use
findings.remediation: Delete wwwroot/sample-data/weather.json and the containing sample-data/ directory.

findings.title: STRUCT-001 follow-up: Infrastructure leak is contained to Program.cs only — no page components are contaminated
findings.rule_violated: Clean Architecture: Dependency Rule (Web should depend only on Core + Services, not Infrastructure)
findings.remediation: Move EnsureCreatedAsync logic into ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddContestJudgingServices (e.g., via an IHostedService or an IContestManager.InitializeAsync method). Then remove the Infrastructure ProjectReference and EF Core/SQLite PackageReferences from Web.csproj.
